lines.tts: Was Ram right, to leave Sita?
We won't judge. Four poets will.

caps: "*RAVANA* held her. | If the king takes her back,
we'll have to bear it | from our wives too."
lines.tts: First, Valmiki. Ayodhya whispered: Ravana held her. If the king takes her back, we'll have to bear it from our wives too.

caps: *RAM* told his brothers: | "My heart knows | she is *PURE.*
But for fear of such blame, | I'd give up | my own *LIFE.*"
lines.tts: Ram told his brothers: My heart knows she is pure. But for fear of such blame, I'd give up my own life.

caps: In *KALIDASA,* | Sita sends the king | a message:
lines.tts: In Kalidas, Sita sends the king a message:

lines.speaker: aditi_en_stories
caps: Still, over gossip, | you left me.
Is that worthy | of your family?"
lines.tts: You saw me pure, in the fire. Still, over gossip, you left me. Is that worthy of your family?

lines.speaker: aditi_en_stories
caps: "Even in my next life, | be my *HUSBAND.*"
lines.tts: Even in my next life, be my husband.

caps: Cast out of his house. | Never out of | his *HEART.*
lines.tts: Cast out of his house. Never out of his heart.

caps: Years later, at his *YAGNA,* | Ram tells *VALMIKI:*
lines.tts: Years later, at his yagna, Ram tells Valmiki: I knew she was sinless. Forgive me.

lines.speaker: aditi_en_stories
caps: "If I have never thought | of anyone but *RAM,*
lines.tts: If I have never thought of anyone but Ram, Mother Earth, open for me.
And the Earth took her home.

caps: Ram never married again. | At every yagna,
lines.tts: Ram never married again. At every yagna, a Sita of gold stood beside him.
Bhavabhuti couldn't bear it. In his play, they are reunited.
And Tulsidas? In his Ramcharitmanas, there is no exile at all.

caps: Even in Valmiki, | the crowd was *DIVIDED.*
lines.tts: Even in Valmiki, the crowd was divided. Well done, Sita! Well done, Ram! And some said: both.

caps: Which *RAMAYAN* | did *YOU* grow up with? | Comment yours.
lines.tts: Which Ramayan did you grow up with? Comment yours.
